title: xyops: A server monitor and a ticketing system rolled into one
description:
If you’ve ever had a cron job fail at 3 AM and had no idea why, you need this. It’s a complete replacement for your crontab, but it’s also a server monitor and a ticketing system rolled into one. Here is the magic: It doesn't just run your scripts blindly. It tracks the CPU and RAM of every single job. And if something crashes? It doesn't just send a vague error email. It auto-creates a ticket with a full snapshot of exactly what the server was doing at that split second.

https://github.com/pixlcore/xyops

#github #opensource
